simple.summary: שׁוּם (shûwm) means garlic (from its rank odor ) First listed occurrence: Num 11 5.

definitions.full: H7762. shuwm [ שׁוּם ] noun [masculine] garlic ; — plural שׁוּמִים Num 11:5 (J) ( allium sativum , Linn, Thes Löw No. 336 Post Hast. DB ii. 110 Tristr NHB 448 (or allium Ascalonicum , compare Buhl, after Tristr FFP 430 ; see this and Post Flora 789 for many kinds of allium ); Arabic , Aramaic תּוּמָא , , Assyrian šûmu ). שֻׁמָתִי see שֻׁמָה infra.
